project_info.name: pair-trading
project_info.description: Brazilian stock market analysis project focusing on pair trading strategies using historical COTAHIST data from B3 exchange

architecture_patterns.file_structure: Flat structure with data files and processing scripts
architecture_patterns.data_flow: Raw COTAHIST -> Processing -> Filtered CSV output

business_domain.focus: Liquidity analysis and pair trading strategies
business_domain.data_scope: Daily trading data including prices and volumes

coding_conventions.file_organization: Single-purpose scripts with clear function definitions
coding_conventions.documentation: Portuguese docstrings with detailed parameter descriptions
coding_conventions.error_handling: Try-catch blocks with user-friendly error messages
coding_conventions.data_types: Pandas DataFrame as primary data structure
coding_conventions.output_format: CSV with semicolon separator and comma decimal
coding_conventions.constants: Defined at module level before function calls

data_standards.encoding: Default system encoding for Brazilian Portuguese

security_considerations.error_disclosure: Avoid exposing sensitive file paths in error messages

performance_considerations.large_files: COTAHIST files are >50MB, require efficient reading
performance_considerations.memory_usage: Process data in chunks when possible
performance_considerations.file_size_limits: Be mindful of output file sizes for analysis tools
